benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.summary: Extends an eligible manufacturer's warranty of 3 years or less by one additional year.

evidence.quote: Extended Warranty Protection extends the time period of the original manufacturer's written U.S. warranty by one additional year, up to $10,000 per claim.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.summary: Covers theft and collision damage for most rental cars when you decline the rental company's coverage.
benefits.limits: up to the actual cash value of the vehicle

evidence.quote: This coverage is secondary to your personal auto insurance.
